midi glove demo.description: i wanted a midi controller that wasn't stuck on one place on stage and wasn't gesture-based. with this glove controller, i can move around as crazy as i want on stage and have all my controls right on me!

why do you think that the world's in the.description: a song written specifically for performing live. playing my voice with the keyboard is magic of sorts. writing original songs for live sets is so much easier than adapting existing material
